Thanks Karthik / Natalie — I pulled a few failed SRP hits from our edge logs for AuroraCo. Short summary: the request from Chrome custom tab is arriving with an unexpected Host and a stripped Cookie header (SameSite fallback), which results in our SRP not seeing the session token and Ariba rejecting the relay (Ariba returns 403 when RelayState validation fails). The ariba-saml-trace attached shows the rejected AuthnRequest with no session cookie.

Observations and proposed short-term fix:
- The invite URLs include an sso_hint query param which we expect to map to a session cookie on redirect. Chrome custom tabs appear to drop/partition the cookie for that origin in some Android versions.
- Proposed mitigation: normalize incoming SRP redirects by accepting sso_hint OR login_hint OR fallback_token in query string and rewrite to append a stable relay id we control before forwarding to Ariba. This avoids relying on the browser's cookie.
- Technical change: small middleware on /srp/redirect that checks for cookie presence and, if missing, rewrites the request to use the fallback_token (we can generate a one-time relay id). I can ship a canary patch to staging and then prod in the next 24–36 hours.

Example curl we tested locally:
curl -v "https://srp.redwood.com/redirect?sso_hint=abc123&relayState=..." -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) Chrome/102"

I'll open SUP-4321 and link the trace. If AuroraCo can share the exact failing link text we will validate the normalization and unstick the flow quickly.

Ben Carter
